title: A Comprehensive Benchmark for COVID-19 Predictive Modeling Using Electronic Health Records in Intensive Care
reasoning: The paper includes a dedicated section (Section C: Evaluation of Prediction Fairness) that extensively discusses and evaluates models based on fairness metrics (Disparate Impact, Average Odds Difference, Equal Opportunity Difference, and Statistical Parity Difference). This goes beyond a brief ethical considerations section and constitutes a component of evaluating ethics in AI.
